races.display_title: Twilight Racing On The Dee Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: JIAIR MADRIK arrives here firmly on the up and this uncomplicated front runner representing a yard with an excellent record at this track may well add to his winning sequence. races.verdict: HI LORD can have his run at Ayr a month ago ignored after meeting trouble leaving the stalls and, having dropped back down to his last winning mark, he is fancied to gain a second victory of the season. Last year's winner of this race Dream Deal isn't taken lightly, though, along with Ideal Guest who is the likely pace angle. HI LORD DREAM DEAL IDEAL GUEST (FR)

races.verdict: TAAKLAM found a chunk of improvement fitted with first-time cheekpieces to get off the mark at Southwell 8 days ago and appealing the type to carry on winning now back on track, Harriet Bethell's 6-y-o can defy a 6-lb penalty. Kilmac Air shaped well on first outing for this yard at Carlisle recently, so she heads up the dangers returned to 7f, with last-time-out winner Lanarra rounding off the shortlist. TAAKLAM (IRE) KILMAC AIR (IRE) LANARRA (IRE)

races.verdict: CAPTAIN CESS has made a very good start for new connections and with this return to 7f in his favour, Declan Carroll's 4-y-o is fancied to double his tally. Filey Beach has largely held his form since landing back-to-back C&D handicaps in May, so he looks the main threat, with Electric Lightning and Showtime Mahomes taken to fight out minor honours. races.verdict: Preference is for NOBLE EXHIBIT , who made a promising debut when third at the Curragh and can step forward from that effort as he goes up in trip. He gets the vote ahead of stablemate City of Gold with Aidan O'Brien bidding for a fifth consecutive win in this race, while Leadlight was only edged out last time and could be thereabouts once more. NOBLE EXHIBIT (IRE) CITY OF GOLD LEADLIGHT (IRE)

races.display_title: Ardilaun Hotel Irish EBF Oyster Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed)
races.verdict: Joseph O'Brien is responsible for nearly half of the field and may land this race for the third time since 2018 courtesy of BESET , who has a strong record fresh and is likely to have going to suit on her first start since the spring. Promising 3-y-o Chasing Paradise is another who hasn't been seen for a while, possibly to avoid summer going, and may provide the chief threat ahead of fellow lightly-raced sort Classiest . Snapretend , a stablemate of the selection, completes the shortlist. BESET CHASING PARADISE (IRE) CLASSIEST (IRE)

races.display_title: Sean Cleary Memorial Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: PORTERS CORNER was only just edged out in a C&D maiden 6 weeks ago and she has every chance of going one better with further improvement likely. Zadawa should be bang there again, while useful hurdler Thisistheway is an intriguing contender. PORTERS CORNER (FR) ZADAWA (FR) THISISTHEWAY (IRE)
